hypothesis: A fully-connected network on flattened 64x64 pixels can separate photos from other images
lesson: High bias: an MLP on flattened pixels cannot fit the task (train 85%). Paintings rejected only 52% of the time -> use a CNN

hypothesis: A simple CNN trained on photo vs text/schematics generalises to paintings and sketches
lesson: Trained without paintings/sketches, it calls 84% of paintings photos: a model only learns distinctions present in its training data -> train on all sources

hypothesis: The same CNN trained on all sources learns to reject paintings and sketches
lesson: Adding hard sources: F1 0.69 -> 0.83, but train 99.9% vs val 90.8%: high variance (val loss rises while train loss falls) -> regularise

hypothesis: Augmentation + BatchNorm + L2 + GAP + dropout + early stopping close E3's generalisation gap
lesson: Gap closed (train 89.2 / val 89.3) but F1 0.808 < E3: over-regularised, bias went up (trade-off). Defaults are not tuned values -> E4b sweep; from-scratch CNN capped ~90% -> transfer learning

hypothesis: ImageNet features (frozen MobileNetV2) separate photos from paintings better than a CNN from scratch
lesson: Transfer learning: F1 0.83 -> 0.946, AUC 0.995 with only 1,281 trained weights; low bias and low variance. Remaining errors: realistic paintings -> fine-tune the top layers

hypothesis: Fine-tuning the top 40 MobileNetV2 layers at a low learning rate improves on E5
lesson: Test F1 0.962 / AUC 0.997. Weakness: grayscale photos (recall 96.2 -> 91.9%), old sepia prints missed. Some errors are label noise in the archives

hypothesis: Lighter regularisation (dropout 0.2, L2 1e-05) than E4 lowers bias while keeping the gap small
lesson: Lighter reg. did NOT lower bias: early stopping fired at epoch 9 on oscillating val loss (best ep 4), F1 0.776

hypothesis: Lighter regularisation (dropout 0.0, L2 1e-05) than E4 lowers bias while keeping the gap small
lesson: No dropout: even earlier stop (epoch 8), F1 0.736 -> dropout also stabilises training

hypothesis: Lighter regularisation (dropout 0.4, L2 0.0) than E4 lowers bias while keeping the gap small
lesson: Dropout 0.4 without L2: best from-scratch CNN, F1 0.850 / AUC 0.969, gap 0.4 pt -> L2 was over-constraining. Val loss still oscillates -> LR schedule (E4c)

hypothesis: With E4b-3 regularisation, halving the LR on plateau and patience 10 stabilise training and lower bias further
lesson: LR halved on plateau (5x) + patience 10: val loss stabilised (0.21-0.23 vs 0.37-0.76), best epoch 22, F1 0.861 / AUC 0.978 = best from-scratch CNN; still far below transfer learning (0.963)

hypothesis: E5 recipe (frozen MobileNetV2) on the complete dataset
E6 recipe (fine-tune 40 layers, lr 1e-5) on the complete dataset reaches at least E6's level
